body:
## Problem

Plan-advisory findings are folded into SUMMARY §6 on every Check (`template/src/pdca_harness/assemble.py:303-306`). That is on purpose: a finding stays visible until the human rules on it. But the ruling does not carry over. `plan-advisory-*.md` is not re-run on iterate-do, so the same file is re-read each round, and every finding comes back as an open `- [ ]` row.

So on a bundle that iterates, the human clears the same plan findings again at each round, even after a re-plan has addressed them.

## Evidence (eduralph/pdca-pdca, v0.58.0, signed off 2026-09-30)

- issue_409: 5 plan findings (soft_auto_iters, convergence baseline, whole_on_missing, clause-4 red leg, split) re-entered §6 at every one of 4 rounds. They had been resolved by the Plan re-scope and cleared by the human at iteration 3. The bundle's own §10 records it: "plan-advisory findings should not re-surface once the brief is revised past them."
- issue_408: 6 plan findings in §6 across 3 rounds.
- issue_371 and issue_477 (1 round each) show the normal case: each finding cleared once.

## Possible fixes

1. Carry the human's tick on a plan-advisory row across iterate-do, keyed by the finding text (the #409 deferred-findings ledger is the natural place, PR #598).
2. Or fold plan findings into §6 only on the first Check after a Plan (or re-plan), and list them read-only after that.

## Done when

A plan-advisory finding the human ticked at round N does not come back as an open §6 row at round N+1, unless Plan was re-run and re-raised it. A test pins it.

Raised by the eduralph/pdca-pdca Act review of 2026-09-30.
title: §6: a plan-advisory finding the human cleared comes back as an open row at every later Check round
